<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <text x="66" y="621" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="medium" fill="#4A4A4A">Your Boost starts immediately</text>
